phaseName: P0 spike done (CLI yes, Desktop no) · P1 magnifier done, reads the pane (adr.rg.017) · P2 session panel built, exit criterion open · P3 threshold alerts built
state: Session 2 (13.9.2026): THE GLASS READS THE PANE. The owner's verdict on session 1 was that the glass did not yet make the work easier: Follow swung the picture sideways with the hand, and a fixed width was wrong over two Code-tab columns and over five. adr.rg.017 (Atlas #302, renumbered #303, guard record #304): the capture engine detects the column under the cursor from a 400 px band of pixels — uniform vs textured columns, a gutter or a border line is a boundary — structure never content, adr.rg.006 intact, UI Automation deliberately not a dependency. On it: Pane lock (Follow takes the row from the cursor, the column from the pane), Fit (the glass's width follows the pane at the current zoom, capped at the monitor, the zoom in effect lowered and shown as such when it must; the user's own zoom and width are never overwritten by a derived value), and a fourth window, the viewfinder (rg.finder-window), click-through and capture-excluded, framing the source rectangle on screen. The bar carries both toggles and says 'no column here' when nothing is found. Seven detector unit tests; idle CPU 2.3-3.7 % of a core with a churning screen, lock on and off alike; geometry verified by reading window rects back on the release build. What the finder draws over real Code-tab columns is for the owner to see: every ReviewGlass window is excluded from capture, so the build agent cannot. Session 1 (11.-12.9.2026): from spec to a tool the owner uses — P0 spike (statusLine is CLI-only), P1 magnifier, P2 session panel, P3 alerts, the glass became a window with three modes, a halo, tray and single instance; sixteen ADRs, docs to the family standard.

End a session by updating docs/CHANGELOG.md, docs/BUILD_INFO.json and, if a lesson was learned, docs/LESSONS.md; put the status to Atlas.
